comments.author: tare
comments.body: Anyone knows what this particular tarot does ?

comments.author: Miyo
comments.body:
Increase skill experience gained by 10%.
Restore ship part's durability by 25% when expired.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Interesting update which we ought to have on Maris now: this tarot effect should now be able to repair damaged ship parts even if a disaster/event at sea should occur -- which probably includes the appearance of those filthy rats with wings known as seagulls. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Update/200616update ("Other" section; reposted for greater clarity)

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Caution: I've received a few reports that seagulls may in fact still cancel this effect. If so, it's either a bug or KOEI forgot to give us that update when they did on JP server and might need a little reminding - you may consider submitting a politely-worded support ticket to inquire and/or report about it.
